CMOS enabled 2-to-4 decoder
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VA a 0 PULSE(0 3.3 40n 100p 100p 39.9n 80n)
VB b 0 PULSE(0 3.3 80n 100p 100p 79.9n 160n)
VEN en 0 PULSE(0 3.3 160n 100p 100p 159.9n 320n)
XDUT vdd 0 en y0 y1 y2 y3 a b astra_031_cmos_enabled_two_to_four_decoder
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec c0y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c1y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c2y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c3y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c4y0 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec c5y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c6y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c7y0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c0y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c1y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c2y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c3y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c4y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c5y1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec c6y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c7y1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c0y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c1y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c2y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c3y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c4y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c5y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c6y2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec c7y2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c0y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c1y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c2y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c3y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c4y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c5y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c6y3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec c7y3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 320n
meas tran c0y0 FIND v(y0) AT=20n
meas tran c1y0 FIND v(y0) AT=60n
meas tran c2y0 FIND v(y0) AT=100n
meas tran c3y0 FIND v(y0) AT=140n
meas tran c4y0 FIND v(y0) AT=180n
meas tran c5y0 FIND v(y0) AT=220n
meas tran c6y0 FIND v(y0) AT=260n
meas tran c7y0 FIND v(y0) AT=300n
meas tran c0y1 FIND v(y1) AT=20n
meas tran c1y1 FIND v(y1) AT=60n
meas tran c2y1 FIND v(y1) AT=100n
meas tran c3y1 FIND v(y1) AT=140n
meas tran c4y1 FIND v(y1) AT=180n
meas tran c5y1 FIND v(y1) AT=220n
meas tran c6y1 FIND v(y1) AT=260n
meas tran c7y1 FIND v(y1) AT=300n
meas tran c0y2 FIND v(y2) AT=20n
meas tran c1y2 FIND v(y2) AT=60n
meas tran c2y2 FIND v(y2) AT=100n
meas tran c3y2 FIND v(y2) AT=140n
meas tran c4y2 FIND v(y2) AT=180n
meas tran c5y2 FIND v(y2) AT=220n
meas tran c6y2 FIND v(y2) AT=260n
meas tran c7y2 FIND v(y2) AT=300n
meas tran c0y3 FIND v(y3) AT=20n
meas tran c1y3 FIND v(y3) AT=60n
meas tran c2y3 FIND v(y3) AT=100n
meas tran c3y3 FIND v(y3) AT=140n
meas tran c4y3 FIND v(y3) AT=180n
meas tran c5y3 FIND v(y3) AT=220n
meas tran c6y3 FIND v(y3) AT=260n
meas tran c7y3 FIND v(y3) AT=300n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
